mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market, increasing inflation expectations and prompting monetary policy tightening, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust aggregate demand, which can trigger inflationary pressures and central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and rising HOUST fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases (i.e., returns are positive in >60% of such instances).

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0), the economy is expanding, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending trend (RSAFS) reflects strong household demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) indicates a weak labor market, which signals economic slack and potential for reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high industrial production (INDPRO > 105.0) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1150.0) indicates a supply-side imbalance, creating economic uncertainty and prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 and HOUST < 1150.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong demand regime (RSAFS > 450,000), elevated consumer spending supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000.
